hero.sub: Most franchise agencies sell you one piece of the puzzle and leave you to stitch it together. We build the entire machine - paid ads, UGC creative, CRM automation, dashboards, and dedicated account management - all working together as one system. Installed once, managed forever.

why.title: Tactics Don't Scale. Systems Do.
why.body: Most franchise brands have a marketing stack that looks like this: one agency for paid ads, another for email, a designer for creative, a VA for reporting, and the franchisee trying to coordinate all of it. Information gets lost between the handoffs. Nobody owns the full outcome. Leads leak at every seam. The brands that scale past 50, 100, 500 locations do it by installing a single integrated system - one team, one dashboard, one source of truth - so every franchisee gets the same engine on day one.

introHeader.title: Every Piece. Connected. Working Together.
introHeader.body: Most agencies sell you one piece of the puzzle. We build the entire machine - from ad click to closed deal - and manage it for you.

features.title: Predictable Local Lead Flow
features.paragraph: Every franchise location gets its own hyper-local ad engine on Meta and Google, managed by our team, optimized daily. We run the campaigns, own the creative, test the audiences, and deliver a predictable volume of qualified leads every single month. No more guessing. No more "marketing months." Just a steady flow of leads tuned to your brand, your geography, and your offer.

bullets.label: Hyper-local targeting
bullets.rest: tuned to each location's specific market

bullets.label: Continuous optimization
bullets.rest: across creative, audience, and bid strategy

bullets.label: Unified campaign structure
bullets.rest: that works across every location and every brand

link.label: See how our paid ads work

features.title: UGC Creative Engine
features.paragraph: Paid ads don't work without creative that actually converts. We coach your franchisees to shoot authentic local content, edit it into ad-ready clips, and deploy it directly into live campaigns every cycle. The result: localized creative that outperforms stock photography by 30-50%, turning every franchise location into its own content studio - without adding headcount.

features.title: CRM & Automation
features.paragraph: The leads from your ads land in a fully configured GoHighLevel environment - sub-accounts per location, automatic lead routing by zip code, speed-to-lead workflows firing within 60 seconds, and visual pipelines so every location knows exactly where every opportunity stands. No lead falls through the cracks. No franchisee wonders where a prospect is in the funnel.

bullets.label: Zip-code lead routing
bullets.rest: to the correct location in under 5 seconds

bullets.label: Multi-channel notifications
bullets.rest: via SMS, email, and mobile app

features.title: Email & SMS Follow-Up
features.paragraph: The moment a lead hits the CRM, our automated follow-up engine takes over. New-lead confirmation fires in under 60 seconds. 24-hour reminders, no-show recovery, post-visit review requests, and long-term nurture sequences all run on autopilot, across every location, 24/7. The franchisee's team focuses on real human conversations that close deals. The system handles everything else.

bullets.label: No-show recovery
bullets.rest: that rebooks up to 42% of missed appointments

bullets.label: Long-term nurture
bullets.rest: that re-engages dormant leads at 30, 60, 90 days

features.title: 5E Insight Engine
features.paragraph: Every stage above feeds data into the 5E Insight Engine - live dashboards that show exactly what's happening across every location, every campaign, every creative. Franchisees see their own numbers. Franchisors see the network rollup. Our team sees where to optimize next. One source of truth, updated in real time. No more waiting for monthly reports to find out what went wrong three weeks ago.

bullets.label: Creative leaderboards
bullets.rest: showing which ads are winning and fatiguing

bullets.label: ROI attribution
bullets.rest: connecting ad spend all the way to signed members

features.title: Dedicated CSM Support
features.paragraph: Software and automation get you 80% of the way. The last 20% is human. Every brand we work with gets a dedicated Client Success Manager who knows your entire franchise system: your locations, your offers, your franchisees, your pain points. Monthly strategy calls, personalized Loom recaps, Slack access for real-time support. You're not a ticket number in a queue. You're a partner with a dedicated team that owns your outcome.
